description: Screenshot of a tweet from Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump), dated 20 May 2018, demanding that the Department of Justice look into whether the FBI/DOJ infiltrated or surveilled the Trump campaign for political purposes and whether any such demands were made by people in the Obama administration. This is Trump's claim/demand as tweeted.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Following. I hereby demand, and will do so officially tomorrow, that the Department of Justice look into whether or not the FBI/DOJ infiltrated or surveilled the Trump Campaign for Political Purposes - and if any such demands or requests were made by people within the Obama Administration! 1:37 PM - 20 May 2018
flags: The tweet's allegation of politically motivated surveillance is a claim, not an established fact.

description: Elevated photograph looking down on the Supertree Grove at Gardens by the Bay in Singapore, with its distinctive purple-red tree-like vertical garden towers, elevated walkway, surrounding gardens, domed conservatory roofs and greenery. Apparently taken from a high vantage such as the Marina Bay Sands SkyPark. The filename 'SING_CLAS_P_L1' was read by followers as signalling Q/POTUS presence in Singapore around the June 2018 summit. No text in the image.

Screenshot of a news article excerpt (attribution line credits Fox News' Pamela K. Browne and Cyd Upson) embedding a Donald J. Trump tweet dated Jun 5, 2018. The tweet claims Strzok-Page texts refer to a counter-intelligence operation into the Trump campaign dating back to December 2015 and declares 'SPYGATE is in full force!' The article text restates the president's claim.
text: Donald J. Trump. @realDonaldTrump. Wow, Strzok-Page, the incompetent & corrupt FBI lovers, have texts referring to a counter-intelligence operation into the Trump Campaign dating way back to December, 2015. SPYGATE is in full force! Is the Mainstream Media interested yet? Big stuff! 7:37 PM - Jun 5, 2018. 86.9K. 44.2K people are talking about this. Late Tuesday, Trump claimed on Twitter that texts exist between Strzok and Page "referring to a counter-intelligence operation into the Trump Campaign dating way back to December, 2015. "SPYGATE is in full force!" the president added. Fox News' Pamela K. Browne and Cyd Upson contributed to this report.
flags: The tweet's characterization of the texts and 'SPYGATE' is Trump's claim as reported.

description: Photograph taken from an aircraft at cruising altitude over a solid cloud deck, with deep blue sky above and dark ocean visible at the cloud edge; several snow-covered volcanic peaks poke through the clouds in the distance. The filename 'Alaska_Vols_G7_SING' was read by followers as Alaskan volcanoes photographed en route between the G7 summit and Singapore in June 2018. No text in the image.
flags: Location (Alaska) is inferred from the filename, not verifiable from the image itself.

description: Graphic of a Drudge Report front-page headline: a photograph of Paul Manafort in a suit, eyes downcast, above the underlined headline 'MANAFORT BEHIND BARS / PRESIDENT RIPS FBI 'SCUM'' and the Drudge Report logo. Refers to Manafort's June 2018 jailing after his bail was revoked.
